title: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) — Mock 17
pattern: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 120 min · no −ve)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL conductor tension is maximum at:
questions.solution: Max tension: coldest temperature (lowest sag, highest tension)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL conductor sag is maximum at:
questions.solution: Max sag: highest temperature (thermal expansion)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Vibration damper (Stockbridge damper) prevents:
questions.solution: Stockbridge: tuned mass damper for wind-induced vibration

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Ice loading on OHL conductors increases:
options: Mechanical load and sag, may cause conductor failure
questions.solution: Ice: adds weight, increases sag and tension

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Wind loading on OHL affects:
options: Conductor sway, sag, and structural loading
questions.solution: Wind: lateral deflection, increased tension on supports

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable tray installation requires:
options: Support spacing per standards, fire barriers, and proper bend radius
questions.solution: Tray: max support spacing 1.5-2m, fire barriers at walls

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable duct installation requires:
options: Draw-in rope, lubricant, and mandrel for pulling
questions.solution: Duct: draw rope + lubricant + tension monitoring

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable joint heat shrink kit includes:
options: Insulation tube, semi-conducting layers, stress cone, end cap
questions.solution: Kit: complete layers for proper insulation and stress control

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable fault types include:
options: Open circuit, short circuit, high resistance, sheath fault
questions.solution: Types: open, short, high-R, cross, sheath

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable insulation resistance decreases with:
questions.solution: IR decreases with temperature (negative temperature coefficient)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable derating for grouping of cables in tray:
options: Reduce rating based on number of adjacent cables
questions.solution: Grouping: mutual heating requires derating per IEC

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: 3-core cable used instead of 3 single-core cables because:
options: Lower cost, simpler installation, common armour
questions.solution: 3-core: cheaper, single armour, simpler termination

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Single-core cable used for HV because:
options: Higher voltage rating, no mutual heating between phases
questions.solution: Single-core: better for HV, no inter-conductor heating

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable armour strip angle is typically:
questions.solution: Armour wire/strips applied helically at ~54°

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL conductor creep is compensated by:
options: Initial sag less than design value
questions.solution: Pre-sag: install with less sag to account for creep

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL dead-end tower withstands:
options: Conductor tension equally from both sides
Full conductor tension from one direction
questions.solution: Dead-end: supports full tension from terminated conductors

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL angle tower withstands:
options: Conductor tension in a straight line
Resultant force from conductors at angle
questions.solution: Angle tower: resultant of conductor tensions on both sides

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A shot-firer who has not been employed in blasting duties for more than 6 months shall undergo:
options: Retraining in the handling of explosives before resuming such duties
Fresh refresher training of six months
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 13: retraining in handling of explosives is required after an absence from such duties exceeding 6 months.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable pulled through long duct run requires:
options: Calculation of pulling tension and sidewall pressure
questions.solution: Tension and sidewall pressure must stay within cable limits

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable splice (joint) location should be:
options: Accessible in manholes/pits, away from bends
questions.solution: Splices in accessible locations for future maintenance

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A person re-employed after an absence exceeding one year from mining work must undergo refresher training within:
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 10: refresher training within 1 month of re-employment after absence over 1 year.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Fire resistant cable maintains circuit integrity during fire for:
questions.solution: Fire rated: 60/90/120/180 minutes circuit integrity

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Low Smoke Zero Halogen (LSZH) cable emits:
options: Minimal smoke and no halogen gases during fire
questions.solution: LSZH: safe for tunnels, buildings, public spaces

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable current rating correction for altitude above 1000m:
options: Reduce rating due to lower air density
questions.solution: Altitude: reduced air cooling -> derating required

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL insulator string length for 132kV is approximately:
questions.solution: 132kV: ~11kV per disc, so 9-12 discs in string

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL insulator contamination (pollution) causes:
questions.solution: Pollution: reduced creepage distance -> flashover

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Anti-fog insulator has:
options: Deep corrugated profile for longer creepage distance
questions.solution: Anti-fog: undulating surface extends creepage path

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cap and pin insulator is used for:
options: Voltages up to 33kV (pin type) or higher (suspension)
questions.solution: Cap and pin: suspension type for >33kV, pin for ≤33kV

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: As per MVTR 1966, refresher vocational training must be given to persons employed in mines at least once in:
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 8: refresher training at least once in every 5 years.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Dynamic cable rating uses:
options: Real-time temperature and load data for actual ampacity
questions.solution: Dynamic rating: adjusts capacity based on actual conditions

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable pulling lubricant should be:
questions.solution: Lubricant: must be compatible with XLPE/PVC sheath

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable drum jacking for installation uses:
questions.solution: Jack and roller: controlled cable deployment from drum

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable trench width for two cables should be minimum:
questions.solution: Trench: sufficient width for cable spacing and work room

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL conductor galvanizing protects against:
questions.solution: Galvanizing: zinc coating protects steel core from rust

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: ACSR conductor strand configuration shows:
options: Aluminium outer strands and steel core strands (e.g., 30/7)
questions.solution: e.g., 30/7 means 30 Al strands over 7 steel strands

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: AAAC (All Aluminium Alloy Conductor) vs ACSR advantage:
options: Lighter weight, no steel core corrosion
questions.solution: AAAC: lighter, no galvanic corrosion, good strength

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable fault in underground system is first suspected when:
options: Tripping occurs on cable feeder with no visible cause
questions.solution: Suspect cable: repeated tripping, insulation test failure

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Vocational Training Rules 1966, a person before being employed in a mine for the first time must undergo:
options: Informal training under any senior workman
Initial vocational training in the prescribed subjects
A medical certificate from any private practitioner
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 6: every person is given initial vocational training before first employment.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable identification in multi-cable trench uses:
options: Cable markers, tags, route maps, and test equipment
questions.solution: Identification: markers, GIS records, cable locator

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL tower earthing resistance should be:
questions.solution: Tower earth: <10 ohm for lightning protection

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: OHL overhead earth wire protects against:
options: Direct lightning strikes to phase conductors
questions.solution: Earth wire: shield wire, intercepts lightning strikes

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer Dyn11 vector group means:
options: Delta primary, star secondary with 30° lead
questions.solution: Dyn11: D primary, n secondary, 11 o'clock (30° lead)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer YNd1 vector group means:
options: Star primary, delta secondary with 30° lag
questions.solution: YNd1: Y primary (earthed), d secondary, 1 o'clock (30° lag)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer vector group matters for:
questions.solution: Same vector group required for parallel operation

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer no-load loss (iron loss) depends on:
questions.solution: Iron loss: hysteresis + eddy, proportional to V² and f²

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer copper loss depends on:
questions.solution: Copper loss: I²R, varies with load current squared

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: 'Competent person' under the Mines Act 1952 means a person:
options: Appointed by the owner, agent or manager and possessing the prescribed qualifications
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.2(1)(c): a competent person is one appointed by the owner, agent or manager with the prescribed qualifications for the purpose.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A first-aid room is required at a mine where the number of persons employed exceeds:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.21: a first-aid room is required where more than 150 persons are employed.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer silica gel breather removes:
questions.solution: Silica gel: absorbs moisture from air entering conservator

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer oil temperature indicator (OTI) shows:
questions.solution: OTI: top oil temperature via thermometer pocket

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer winding temperature indicator (WTI) shows:
questions.solution: WTI: oil temp + I²R heating = hot spot estimate

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer ONAN cooling means:
questions.solution: ONAN: oil circulates by natural convection, air natural

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: As per the Mines Act 1952, women may be employed aboveground only between:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.46: women shall not be employed belowground, and aboveground employment is restricted between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer OFAF cooling means:
questions.solution: OFAF: forced oil pump + forced air fans

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer OFWF cooling means:
options: Oil Forced Water Forced (oil pump + water heat exchanger)
questions.solution: OFWF: forced oil + forced water cooling

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: On-load tap changer (OLTC) operates in:
options: Oil-filled compartment separate from main tank
questions.solution: OLTC: separate oil compartment due to arcing carbon

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The maximum working hours in a week for an adult employed belowground in a mine are:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.28: no person shall be employed belowground for more than 48 hours in any week.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer short circuit test is performed on:
questions.solution: SC test: apply voltage to HV, short LV, measure Cu loss

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer open circuit test is performed on:
questions.solution: OC test: apply rated V to LV, measure iron loss

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer percentage impedance indicates:
options: Voltage drop at full load as % of rated voltage
questions.solution: Z%: voltage regulation indicator, typically 4-10%

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer % impedance affects:
options: Short circuit current magnitude and voltage regulation
questions.solution: Higher Z%: lower fault current but worse regulation

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Parallel operation of transformers requires:
options: Same vector group, same %Z, same turns ratio
questions.solution: Must match: vector group, voltage ratio, impedance, pf

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer inrush current is:
questions.solution: Inrush: DC offset causes saturation, 6-10x rated

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer inrush current has high content of:
questions.solution: Inrush: rich in 2nd harmonic (used for blocking relay)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: DGA (Dissolved Gas Analysis) acetylene (C2H2) indicates:
questions.solution: C2H2: arcing signature (most critical indicator)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: DGA hydrogen (H2) as sole gas indicates:
questions.solution: H2 alone: usually partial discharge

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, notice of which of the following accidents is required to be given to the prescribed authorities?
options: Loss of life, serious bodily injury, explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water or other matter
Loss of life and serious bodily injury only
Explosion and fire occurring in the opencast part only
Minor injuries and first-aid cases only
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.23: notice is required for loss of life, serious injury, and specified occurrences such as explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer overfluxing (V/f) protection prevents:
options: Core saturation and excessive magnetizing current
questions.solution: Overfluxing: V/f > rated -> saturation -> overheating

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Power transformer rating in MVA is based on:
options: Rated apparent power at specified ambient temperature
questions.solution: MVA: apparent power rating at rated conditions

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Generator transformer steps up from:
questions.solution: GT: generator voltage to transmission voltage

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Station transformer steps down from:
questions.solution: ST: grid/HT to plant auxiliary (415V, 11kV)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Unit transformer is dedicated to:
questions.solution: UT: dedicated auxiliary transformer per generating unit

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer differential protection uses:
options: CTs on HV and LV sides with ratio matching
questions.solution: Diff: compare I_HV and I_LV with CT ratio correction

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, an Inspector may, among other powers:
options: Enter, inspect and examine a mine, and make inquiries on any matter relating to safety
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.22: Inspectors may enter, inspect, examine and inquire into any mine and its records.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: When workings approach within 60 m of a water body or waterlogged area, the manager shall:
options: Stop working immediately without any plan
Leave the water body untouched forever
Install a signal lamp near the water body and continue working
Prepare a scheme for protection against inrush and drain the water in a planned manner
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 149 (danger from surface water) & Ch. XI: within 60 m, protective schemes (drainage, barriers) are implemented.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In return airways and old workings, the air shall normally contain oxygen not less than ______ and carbon dioxide not more than ______.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 165: not less than 19% oxygen and not more than 0.5% carbon dioxide.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer bushing CT (BCT) is used for:
options: Differential protection by measuring current through bushing
questions.solution: BCT: built into bushing for differential protection

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer pressure relief device (PRD) operates when:
options: Internal pressure rises above safe limit
questions.solution: PRD: opens to release pressure from internal fault

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer surge diverter (lightning arrestor) is connected:
questions.solution: LA: line terminal to earth for surge protection

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer oil filter plant removes:
options: Moisture, particles, and dissolved gases from oil
questions.solution: Oil processing: vacuum dehydration + filtration

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: A 300 m train crosses a 200 m platform in 25 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.solution: Distance = 500 m. Speed = 500/25 = 20 m/s = 72 km/h

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The ratio of three numbers is 2:3:4. The sum of the largest and smallest equals the middle number increased by 14. What is the smallest number?
questions.solution: Numbers: 2x, 3x, 4x. 4x + 2x = 3x + 14 → 3x = 14 → x = 14/3. Smallest = 28/3. Not matching... Let me reconsider. Maybe: 2x + 4x = 3x + 14 → 3x = 14 → x ≈ 4.67. Smallest = 9.33. Still not matching. Perhaps the sum equals the middle + 14: 2x+4x = 3x+14 → x=14/3. Not an integer.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: In an examination, 35% students failed in Maths and 25% in English. 10% failed in both. What percentage passed in both subjects?
questions.solution: Failed in at least one = 35 + 25 - 10 = 50%. Passed in both = 100 - 50 = 50%

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: If Monday is 1st day, what is the 15th day?
questions.solution: 15 mod 7 = 1; 15th = same as 1st = Monday... actually: day 1=Mon, day 8=Mon, day 15=Mon

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Coding: if DELHI is coded as CCIDD, how is MUMBAI coded?
questions.solution: DELHI→CCIDD shifts each letter back by 1,2,3,4,5. MUMBAI: M-1=L, U-2=S, M-3=J, B-4=X, A-5=V, I-6=C → LSJXVC.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: If in a code, MACHINE is written as NBDIJOF, then how is DANGER written?
questions.solution: Each letter shifts forward by one: M→N, A→B, C→D, H→I, I→J, N→O, E→F. DANGER → E B O H F S.

questions.solution: East -> South -> West. Final: West
